final androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher<android.content.Intent> cssFilePick = registerForActivityResult(
new androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts.StartActivityForResult(),
new androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultCallback<androidx.activity.result.ActivityResult>() {
@Override
@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
public void onActivityResult(androidx.activity.result.ActivityResult res) {
android.webkit.ValueCallback<android.net.Uri[]> cb = (android.webkit.ValueCallback<android.net.Uri[]>) cssFileCb[0];
cssFileCb[0] = null;
if (cb == null) return;
android.net.Uri[] out = null;
android.content.Intent d = res.getData();
if (res.getResultCode() == RESULT_OK && d != null) {
if (d.getClipData() != null && d.getClipData().getItemCount() > 0) {
int n = d.getClipData().getItemCount();
out = new android.net.Uri[n];
for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = d.getClipData().getItemAt(i).getUri();
} else if (d.getData() != null) {
out = new android.net.Uri[]{d.getData()};
}
}
cb.onReceiveValue(out);
}
});

/* V114: ponte de arquivos do app (CssStudioApp) — salvar, salvar como, compartilhar, abrir e recarregar */
abstract class CssUriCb {

}
class CssFiles {
String safeName(String name) {
String s = name == null ? "arquivo" : name.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]", "_").trim();
return s.length() == 0 ? "arquivo" : s;
}
String mimeOf(String mime) {
return (mime == null || mime.length() == 0) ? "application/octet-stream" : mime.split(";")[0].trim();
}
void js(final String code) {
binding.webview1.post(new Runnable() {
public void run() {
binding.webview1.evaluateJavascript(code, null);
}
});
}
/* grava na pasta Downloads; devolve "ok:Downloads/nome|endereço" ou "err:motivo" */
String saveDl(String name, String mime, byte[] data) {
try {
String safe = safeName(name);
if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) {
android.content.ContentValues cv = new android.content.ContentValues();
cv.put(android.provider.MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME, safe);
cv.put(android.provider.MediaStore.MediaColumns.MIME_TYPE, mimeOf(mime));
cv.put(android.provider.MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH, android.os.Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS);
android.net.Uri uri = getContentResolver().insert(android.provider.MediaStore.Downloads.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, cv);
if (uri == null) return "err:uri";
java.io.OutputStream os = getContentResolver().openOutputStream(uri);
if (os == null) return "err:stream";
os.write(data);
os.close();
return "ok:Downloads/" + safe + "|" + uri.toString();
}
if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 23 && checkSelfPermission(android.Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) != android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
runOnUiThread(new Runnable() {
public void run() {
requestPermissions(new String[]{android.Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE}, 1114);
}
});
return "err:perm";
}
java.io.File dir = android.os.Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(android.os.Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS);
if (!dir.exists()) dir.mkdirs();
java.io.File f = new java.io.File(dir, safe);
int k = 2;
String base = safe.replaceAll("(\\.[^.]*)$", "");
String ext = safe.length() > base.length() ? safe.substring(base.length()) : "";
while (f.exists()) {
f = new java.io.File(dir, base + " (" + k + ")" + ext);
k++;
}
java.io.FileOutputStream fo = new java.io.FileOutputStream(f);
fo.write(data);
fo.close();
android.media.MediaScannerConnection.scanFile(MainActivity.this, new String[]{f.getAbsolutePath()}, new String[]{mimeOf(mime)}, null);
return "ok:Downloads/" + f.getName() + "|file:" + f.getAbsolutePath();
} catch (Exception e) {
return "err:" + e.getMessage();
}
}
/* transforma o endereço devolvido por saveDl em content:// para abrir/compartilhar */
void withUri(String token, String mime, final CssUriCb cb) {
if (token == null || token.length() == 0) {
cb.got(null);
return;
}
if (token.startsWith("content:")) {
cb.got(android.net.Uri.parse(token));
return;
}
String path = token.startsWith("file:") ? token.substring(5) : token;
android.media.MediaScannerConnection.scanFile(MainActivity.this, new String[]{path}, new String[]{mimeOf(mime)},
new android.media.MediaScannerConnection.OnScanCompletedListener() {
public void onScanCompleted(String p, final android.net.Uri uri) {
runOnUiThread(new Runnable() {
public void run() {
cb.got(uri);
}
});
}
});
}
@android.webkit.JavascriptInterface
public String features() {
return "saveFile,saveAs,share,open,multi,downloads,v114";
}
/* salva direto na pasta Downloads (recebe o conteúdo em base64) */
@android.webkit.JavascriptInterface
public String saveFile(String name, String mime, String base64) {
try {
return saveDl(name, mime, android.util.Base64.decode(base64, android.util.Base64.DEFAULT));
} catch (Exception e) {
return "err:" + e.getMessage();
}
}
/* abre o "Salvar como" do Android; a resposta chega em __cssNative.done(id, resultado) */
@android.webkit.JavascriptInterface
public String saveAs(final String id, final String name, final String mime, String base64) {
try {
cssPend[0] = android.util.Base64.decode(base64, android.util.Base64.DEFAULT);
cssPend[1] = id;
runOnUiThread(new Runnable() {
public void run() {
try {
android.content.Intent it = new android.content.Intent(android.content.Intent.ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT);
it.addCategory(android.content.Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE);
it.setType(mimeOf(mime));
it.putExtra(android.content.Intent.EXTRA_TITLE, safeName(name));
cssSaveAs.launch(it);
} catch (Exception e) {
cssPend[0] = null;
cssPend[1] = null;
js("window.__cssNative&&__cssNative.done(" + org.json.JSONObject.quote(id) + "," + org.json.JSONObject.quote("err:" + e.getMessage()) + ")");
}
}
});
return "ok:pending";
} catch (Exception e) {
return "err:" + e.getMessage();
}
}
/* compartilha (WhatsApp, Drive, e-mail...): usa o arquivo já salvo ou salva antes */
@android.webkit.JavascriptInterface
public String share(String token, final String name, final String mime, String base64) {
try {
String t = token == null ? "" : token;
if (t.length() == 0 && base64 != null && base64.length() > 0) {
String r = saveDl(name, mime, android.util.Base64.decode(base64, android.util.Base64.DEFAULT));
if (!r.startsWith("ok:")) return r;
t = r.indexOf('|') >= 0 ? r.substring(r.indexOf('|') + 1) : "";
}
withUri(t, mime, new CssUriCb() {
void got(android.net.Uri uri) {
if (uri == null) {
js("window.__cssNative&&__cssNative.msg('noshare')");
return;
}
try {
android.content.Intent s = new android.content.Intent(android.content.Intent.ACTION_SEND);
s.setType(mimeOf(mime));
s.putExtra(android.content.Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, uri);
s.putExtra(android.content.Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT, safeName(name));
s.addFlags(android.content.Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION);
startActivity(android.content.Intent.createChooser(s, safeName(name)));
} catch (Exception e) {
js("window.__cssNative&&__cssNative.msg('noshare')");
}
}
});
return "ok";
} catch (Exception e) {
return "err:" + e.getMessage();
}
}
/* abre o arquivo salvo no app certo (navegador, editor de texto, galeria...) */
@android.webkit.JavascriptInterface
public String open(String token, final String mime) {
withUri(token, mime, new CssUriCb() {
void got(android.net.Uri uri) {
if (uri == null) {
js("window.__cssNative&&__cssNative.msg('noapp')");
return;
}
try {
android.content.Intent v = new android.content.Intent(android.content.Intent.ACTION_VIEW);
v.setDataAndType(uri, mimeOf(mime));
v.addFlags(android.content.Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION);
startActivity(v);
} catch (Exception e) {
js("window.__cssNative&&__cssNative.msg('noapp')");
}
}
});
return "ok";
}
@android.webkit.JavascriptInterface
public void reload() {
runOnUiThread(new Runnable() {
public void run() {
binding.webview1.loadDataWithBaseURL("https://cssstudiopro.local/", html, "text/html", "UTF-8", null);
}
});
}
}
final CssFiles cssFiles = new CssFiles();
binding.webview1.addJavascriptInterface(cssFiles, "CssStudioApp");

/* V114: qualquer download que escape da ponte (prévias, sites publicados, links) também é salvo */
binding.webview1.setDownloadListener(new android.webkit.DownloadListener() {
public void onDownloadStart(String url, String userAgent, String contentDisposition, String mimetype, long contentLength) {
String name = android.webkit.URLUtil.guessFileName(url, contentDisposition, mimetype);
try {
if (url.startsWith("blob:")) {
cssFiles.js("window.__cssNative&&__cssNative.blob(" + org.json.JSONObject.quote(url) + "," + org.json.JSONObject.quote(name) + "," + org.json.JSONObject.quote(mimetype == null ? "" : mimetype) + ")");
} else if (url.startsWith("data:")) {
int c = url.indexOf(',');
String head = url.substring(5, c);
String body = url.substring(c + 1);
boolean b64 = head.endsWith(";base64");
String mime = b64 ? head.substring(0, head.length() - 7) : head;
byte[] data = b64 ? android.util.Base64.decode(body, android.util.Base64.DEFAULT) : java.net.URLDecoder.decode(body, "UTF-8").getBytes("UTF-8");
String r = cssFiles.saveDl(name, mime, data);
cssFiles.js("window.__cssNative&&__cssNative.saved(" + org.json.JSONObject.quote(name) + "," + org.json.JSONObject.quote(cssFiles.mimeOf(mime)) + "," + org.json.JSONObject.quote(r) + ")");
} else {
android.app.DownloadManager dm = (android.app.DownloadManager) getSystemService(android.content.Context.DOWNLOAD_SERVICE);
android.app.DownloadManager.Request rq = new android.app.DownloadManager.Request(android.net.Uri.parse(url));
rq.setMimeType(mimetype);
rq.setNotificationVisibility(android.app.DownloadManager.Request.VISIBILITY_VISIBLE_NOTIFY_COMPLETED);
rq.setDestinationInExternalPublicDir(android.os.Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS, name);
dm.enqueue(rq);
cssFiles.js("window.__cssNative&&__cssNative.msg('dl')");
}
} catch (Exception e) {
cssFiles.js("window.__cssNative&&__cssNative.msg('err')");
}
}
});

binding.webview1.loadDataWithBaseURL("https://cssstudiopro.local/", html, "text/html", "UTF-8", null);
